description: Returns measure.py with a confirmed spec written in: a fixed Python script (standard library, no network, fixed seeds) that counts what each check needs from a data file and prints those counts with its own fingerprint and no rows. Reads .csv or .json. If the spec has errors, returns the errors instead.

columns.description: Optional: the column names of the file, to check the spec refers to real columns.

spec.description: The spec from start_audit, as confirmed by the person.
